user.title: Connect to FSL
user.description: Enter the sign-in code for the FSL IoT cloud. It will be saved to renew your access token automatically.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to FSL
reauth_confirm.description: Your FSL session could not be renewed. Enter the sign-in code once to save it for future automatic token renewal. Your existing devices and entities will be kept.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the FSL IoT cloud. Please check your network and try again.
error.invalid_auth: The sign-in code was rejected. Please check the code and try again.
